cases.sentence: Затем я услышал ___ из храма, говорящий семи ангелам:
cases.explain: «громкий голос» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”

cases.sentence: ___ пошел и вылил содержимое своей чаши на сушу.
cases.explain: «Первый ангел» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and evil sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.

cases.sentence: ___ вылил содержимое своей чаши в море, и вода моря превратилась в кровь, напоминающую кровь мертвеца, и все живое в море умерло.
cases.explain: «Второй ангел» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.

cases.sentence: ___ вылил содержимое своей чаши на реки и на источники вод, и те также превратились в кровь .
cases.explain: «Третий ангел» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

cases.sentence: Их жгла ___, и они проклинали Имя Бога, имеющего власть над этими бедствиями.
cases.explain: «невыносимая жара» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn’t repent and give him glory.

cases.sentence: ___ вылил содержимое своей чаши на трон зверя, и все царство зверя погрузилось во тьму .
cases.explain: «Пятый ангел» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,

cases.sentence: ___ вылил содержимое своей чаши в великую реку Евфрат.
cases.explain: «Шестой ангел» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.

cases.sentence: ___ вылил содержимое своей чаши в воздух, и из храма небесного, от трона, прозвучал громкий голос:
cases.explain: «Седьмой ангел» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”

cases.sentence: Седьмой ангел вылил содержимое своей чаши в воздух, и из храма небесного, от трона, прозвучал ___:
cases.explain: «громкий голос» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”

cases.sentence: Тогда засверкали молнии, зазвучали голоса, загремел гром, и произошло ___.
cases.explain: «сильное землетрясение» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake, such as has not happened since there were men on the earth, so great an earthquake, and so mighty.

cases.sentence: Такого ___ не было за все время существования людей на земле!
cases.explain: «мощного землетрясения» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake, such as has not happened since there were men on the earth, so great an earthquake, and so mighty.

cases.sentence: ___ раскололся на три части, и города народов пали.
cases.explain: «Великий город» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

cases.sentence: Так Бог не забыл великий Вавилон, Он дал ему выпить чашу, полную вина Его ___.
cases.explain: «яростного гнева» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
